Clear the current playback queue? Song metadata, playlists, favorites and audio files will be kept.

Choose a song storage folder before importing. Audio is copied there and played from the copy; files already in the folder are used directly. Copies use device storage. My songs manages metadata, LRC lyrics, artwork, favorites and playlists, and can delete files after confirmation. Removing a song from the playback queue does not delete its file.

Importing or scanning the authorized folder reads embedded artwork, BPM, composer, arranger and artist tags, placing artists in the vocalist field. Metadata stored only in a desktop player’s private database does not travel with the file. Duplicate song titles are allowed: library identity is based on the file, and editing a title does not overwrite audio. Supported formats depend on device codecs.

Background playback, lock-screen and notification controls are supported. Rewind and pause keeps the current song selected. Disconnecting headphones pauses playback. App volume does not change system volume and is capped by the configured maximum; output also depends on system volume and the playback device.

Playback speed ranges from 0.5× to 2×, preserving pitch by default. Repeated keep/remove edits can be joined into a WAV export without changing the original. Exports ignore playback speed by default; offline time stretching may affect audio quality. Audio analysis decodes files without using the microphone.

Data stays on the device. Audio is not uploaded and unauthorized folders are not scanned. Cloud providers in the system picker may use the network. You are responsible for permission to use your files; no music downloads or online catalogue are provided.
